Fiorello H. La Guardia was born on **December 11 1882**.  
At that exact time, the then‑incumbent mayor of New York City was **William Russell Grace**.  

- **William Russell Grace** (May 10 1832 – March 21 1904) served as the **84th mayor of New York City** from **January 1 1881 to December 31 1882**.  
- Thus, on the day La Guardia entered the world, Grace was still in the mayoral office, having been succeeded by Franklin Edson only on New Year’s Day 1883.
